sn42.8:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nālandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane.
sn42.8:1.2: atha kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi nigaṇṭhasāvako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho asibandhakaputtaṃ gāmaṇiṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn42.8:1.3: kathannukho gāmaṇi, nigaṇṭho nātaputto sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desetīti.
sn42.8:1.4: evaṃ kho bhante nigaṇṭho nātaputto sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti:
sn42.8:1.5: yo koci pāṇamatipāteti sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko, yo koci adinnamādiyati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko. yo koci kāmesu micchā carati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko. yo koci musā bhaṇati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko.
sn42.8:1.6: yaṃ bahulaṃ yaṃ bahulaṃ viharati tena tena nīyyatīti.
sn42.8:1.7: evaṃ kho bhante nigaṇṭho nātaputto sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desetīti.
sn42.8:1.8: yaṃ bahulaṃ yaṃ bahulañca gāmaṇi viharati tena tena nīyyatīti evaṃ sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati yathā nigaṇṭhassa nātaputtassa vacanaṃ.
sn42.8:2.2: yo so puriso pāṇātipātī, rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayāsamayaṃ upādāya, katamo bahutaro samayo yaṃ vā so pāṇaṃ atipāteti yaṃ vā so pāṇaṃ nātipātetīti.
sn42.8:2.3: yo so bhante puriso pāṇātipātī, rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayāsamayaṃ upādāya appataro so samayo yaṃ so pāṇaṃ atipāteti. atha kho so va bahutaro samayo yaṃ so pāṇaṃ nātipātetīti.
sn42.8:2.4: yaṃ bahulaṃ yaṃ bahulañca gāmaṇi viharati tena tena nīyyatīti evaṃ sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati yathā nigaṇṭhassa nātaputtassa vacanaṃ.
sn42.8:3.2: yo so puriso adinnādāyī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayāsamayaṃ upādāya katamo bahutaro samayo yaṃ vā so adinnaṃ ādiyati yaṃ vā so adinnaṃ nādiyatīti.
sn42.8:3.3: yo so bhante puriso adinnādāyī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayāsamayaṃ upādāya, appataro so samayo yaṃ so adinnaṃ ādiyati, atha kho sova bahutaro samayo yaṃ so adinnaṃ nādiyatīti.
sn42.8:3.4: yaṃ bahulaṃ yaṃ bahulañca gāmaṇi viharati tena tena nīyyatīti, evaṃ sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati yathā nigaṇṭhassa nātaputtassa vacanaṃ.
sn42.8:4.1: taṃ kimmaññasi gāmaṇi yo so puriso kāmesu micchācārī, rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayāsamayaṃ upādāya katamo bahutaro samayo yaṃ vā so kāmesu micchā carati, yaṃ vā so kāmesu micchā na caratīti.
sn42.8:4.2: yo so bhante puriso kāmesu micchācārī, rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayāsamayaṃ upādāya appataro so samayo yaṃ so kāmesu micchā carati, atha kho sova bahutaro samayo yaṃ so kāmesu micchā na carati.
sn42.8:4.3: yaṃ bahulaṃ yaṃ bahulañca gāmaṇi viharati tena tena nīyyatīti, evaṃ sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati yathā nigaṇṭhassa nātaputtassa vacanaṃ.
sn42.8:5.1: taṃ kimmaññasi gāmaṇi, yo so puriso musāvādī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayāsamayaṃ upādāya katamo bahutaro samayo yaṃ vā so musā bhaṇati yaṃ vā so musā na bhaṇatīti.
sn42.8:5.2: yo so bhante puriso musāvādī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayāsamayaṃ upādāya appataro so samayo yaṃ so musā bhaṇati, atha kho sova bahutaro samayo yaṃ so musā na bhaṇatīti.
sn42.8:5.3: yaṃ bahulaṃ yaṃ bahulañca gāmaṇi viharati tena tena nīyyatīti evaṃ sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati yathā nigaṇṭhassa nātaputtassa vacanaṃ.
sn42.8:6.1: idha gāmaṇi ekacco satthā evaṃvādī hoti evaṃ diṭṭhi:
sn42.8:6.2: yo koci pāṇamatipāteti sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko, yo koci adinnaṃ ādiyati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko, yo koci kāmesu micchā carati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko, yo koci musā bhaṇati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayikoti.
sn42.8:6.3: tasmiṃ kho pana gāmaṇi satthari sāvako abhippasanno hoti.
sn42.8:6.5: mayhaṃ kho satthā evaṃ vādī evaṃ diṭṭhi:
sn42.8:6.6: “yo koci pāṇamatipāteti sabbo so āpāyiko nerayikoti.
sn42.8:6.7: atthi kho pana mayā pāṇo atipātito ahampi āpāyiko nerayikoti diṭṭhiṃ paṭilabhati.
sn42.8:6.8: taṃ gāmaṇi vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
sn42.8:6.9: mayhaṃ kho satthā evaṃ vādī evaṃ diṭṭhi:
sn42.8:6.10: “yo koci adinnaṃ ādiyati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko”ti.
sn42.8:6.11: atthi kho pana mayā adinnaṃ ādinnaṃ, ahampamhi āpāyiko nerayikoti diṭṭhiṃ paṭilabhati.
sn42.8:6.12: taṃ gāmaṇi vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
sn42.8:6.13: mayhaṃ kho satthā evaṃ vādī evaṃ diṭṭhi:
sn42.8:6.14: “yo koci kāmesu micchā carati, sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko”ti.
sn42.8:6.15: atthi kho pana mayā kāmesu micchāciṇṇaṃ,
sn42.8:6.17: taṃ gāmaṇi vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
sn42.8:6.19: “yo koci musā bhaṇati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko”ti.
sn42.8:6.20: atthi kho pana mayā musā bhaṇitaṃ.
sn42.8:6.22: taṃ gāmaṇi vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
sn42.8:7.1: idha pana gāmaṇi tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
sn42.8:7.2: so anekapariyāyena pāṇātipātaṃ garahati vigarahati pāṇātipātāviramathāti cāha.
sn42.8:7.3: adinnādānaṃ garahati vigarahati adinnādānā viramathāti cāha.
sn42.8:7.4: kāmesu micchācāraṃ garahati vigarahati kāmesu micchācārā viramathāti cāha.
sn42.8:7.5: musāvādaṃ garahati vigarahati musāvādā viramathāti cāha.
sn42.8:7.6: tasmiṃ kho pana gāmaṇi satthari sāvako abhippasanno hoti.
sn42.8:7.8: bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena pāṇātipātaṃ garahati vigarahati pāṇātipātā viramathāti cāha:
sn42.8:7.9: atthi kho pana mayā pāṇo atipātito yāvatako vā tāvatako vā:
sn42.8:7.10: yo kho pana mayā pāṇo atipātito yāvatako vā tāvatako vā, taṃ na suṭṭhu taṃ na sādhu.
sn42.8:7.11: ahañceva kho pana tappaccayā vippaṭisārī assaṃ
sn42.8:7.12: na me taṃ pāpakaṃ kammaṃ akataṃ bhavissatīti.
sn42.8:7.13: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya taṃ ceva pāṇātipātaṃ pajahati.
sn42.8:8.1: bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena adinnādānaṃ garahati vigarahati adinnādānā viramathāti cāha.
sn42.8:8.2: atthi kho pana mayā adinnaṃ ādinnaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā:
sn42.8:8.3: yaṃ kho pana mayā adinnaṃ ādinnaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā, taṃ na suṭṭhu taṃ na sādhu.
sn42.8:8.4: ahañceva kho pana tappaccayā vippaṭisārī assaṃ na me taṃ pāpakaṃ kammaṃ akataṃ bhavissatīti.
sn42.8:9.1: bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena kāmesu micchācāraṃ garahati vigarahati, kāmesu micchācārā viramathāti cāha.
sn42.8:9.2: atthi kho pana mayā kāmesu micchāciṇṇaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā.
sn42.8:9.3: yaṃ kho pana mayā kāmesu micchāciṇṇaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā taṃ na suṭṭhu taṃ na sādhu.
sn42.8:9.4: ahañceva kho pana tappaccayā vippaṭisārī assaṃ na me taṃ pāpakaṃ kammaṃ akataṃ bhavissatīti.
sn42.8:9.5: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya tañceva kāmesu micchācāraṃ pajahati, āyatiñca kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti;
sn42.8:10.1: bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena musāvādaṃ garahati vigarahati, musāvādā viramathāti cāha.
sn42.8:10.2: atthi kho pana mayā musā bhaṇitaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā.
sn42.8:10.3: yaṃ kho pana mayā musā bhaṇitaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā, taṃ na suṭṭhu, taṃ na sādhu. ahañceva kho pana tappaccayā vippaṭisārī assaṃ na me taṃ pāpakaṃ kammaṃ akataṃ bhavissatīti.
sn42.8:10.4: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya tañceva musāvādaṃ pajahati, āyatiñca musāvādā paṭivirato hoti.
sn42.8:10.5: evametassa pāpassa kammassa pahānaṃ hoti. evametassa pāpassa kammassa samatikkamo hoti.
sn42.8:11.1: so pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti.
sn42.8:11.3: kāmesu micchācāraṃ pahāya kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti.
sn42.8:11.5: pisuṇāvācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti.
sn42.8:11.6: pharusaṃvācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti.
sn42.8:12.1: sa kho so gāmaṇi ariyasāvako evaṃ vigatābhijjho vigatavyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno patissato mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ; iti uddhamadhotiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjho pharitvā viharati.
sn42.8:12.2: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi balavā saṅkhadhamo appakasireneva catuddisā viññāpeyya,
sn42.8:12.3: evameva kho gāmaṇi evaṃ bhāvitāya mettāya cetovimuttiyā evaṃ bahulīkatāya yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati.
sn42.8:13.1: sa kho so gāmaṇi ariyasāvako evaṃ vigatābhijjho vigatavyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno patissato karuṇāsahagatena cetasā …pe…
sn42.8:13.3: upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadhotiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
sn42.8:13.4: seyyathāpi gāmaṇi balavā saṅkhadhamo appakasireneva catuddisā viññāpeyya,
sn42.8:13.5: evameva kho gāmaṇi evaṃ bhāvitāya upekhāya cetovimuttiyā evaṃ bahulīkatāya yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhatīti.
sn42.8:14.1: evaṃ vutte asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
